linkedOperation.title: Linked operation
linkedOperation.holdingRequired: Choose the investment holding for this operation.
linkedOperation.loanRequired: Choose the loan for this payment.
linkedOperation.splitHint: Investment operations require a transaction without category splits. Remove the split to use one.

effects.BUY: Cash decreases and the holding gains investment units.
effects.SELL: Investment units decrease and the sale proceeds are added to account cash.
effects.ADD: Investment units are added to the holding, with no cash deposit.
effects.REMOVE: Investment units are removed from the holding, with no cash withdrawal.
effects.LOAN_PAYMENT: Cash decreases by the full payment. Only the principal portion reduces the outstanding debt.
effects.MAINTENANCE: Cash decreases and the expense is linked to the selected property or asset. Its value is unchanged.
effects.CAPITAL_IMPROVEMENT: Cash decreases and cost basis increases. Market value changes only by the increase you choose.
effects.INTEREST: Cash increases and the payment is recorded as bank interest.
effects.EXISTING: The existing links and classification are preserved. Use the linked asset or loan to manage this operation.
effects.holdingTransfer: Units are removed from {{holding}} and the transfer is credited to {{destination}}.
effects.cashTransfer: Cash is withdrawn from the source account and credited to {{destination}}.

details.recordedLink: This transaction is linked to the item shown below.
details.fundingUnavailable: The transfer funding details could not be loaded.

investment.title: Investment movement
investment.hint: Link this transaction to investment units held in the selected account.
investment.transferHint: Choose cash or a holding in the source account. A holding-funded transfer removes units and credits the destination account.
investment.conflictHint: Remove the split or other movement link before adding an investment movement.
investment.noHoldings: No eligible holdings are linked to this account. Link an investment asset to this account in Assets first.

effects.ADD: Increases the holding and its cost basis. The amount records acquisition value; account cash stays unchanged.
effects.REMOVE: Reduces the holding. The amount records the value moved; source account cash stays unchanged.
effects.BUY: Increases the holding and its cost basis, and debits account cash.
effects.SELL: Reduces the holding and credits the sale proceeds to account cash.

investment.estimateHint: Estimated from the closing price on the transaction date. Fees and intraday prices can make the actual quantity different.
investment.priceUnavailable: No closing price is available for this date. Enter the exact quantity instead.
investment.estimateExceedsAvailable: This estimate exceeds the units available. The closing price may differ from your actual transfer price. Enter the actual quantity transferred, or check earlier movements.
investment.quantityExceedsAvailable: This quantity exceeds the units available. Check the actual quantity transferred or earlier movements.
investment.priceSource: Source: historical market closing price. This estimate will be saved with the transaction.
investment.savedEstimate: Saved closing-price estimate. Editing notes does not refresh this price.
investment.accountMismatch: Choose a holding linked to the selected account, or remove the investment link.
investment.quantityInvalid: Enter a positive quantity with at most 18 decimal places.
